opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed under § 240 of the Judicial Code as amended by the Act of February 13, 1925 (43 Stat. 936), and, treating the writ of error as a petition for a writ of certiorari, the Court also denies the same.

Mr. Walter A. Hill for plaintiff in error, in opposition thereto.

See post, p. 751.
